title: Getty Bun consumer requirement — contract version 1 (proposal v0.2)
description: Validates the custom gettyBun object inside package.json, not the entire manifest. Bun and the starter do not read it; the consumer's CI checks it against the starters' rendered pin block.

bunVersion.description: Exact stable Bun version; no v prefix, ranges, tags, prereleases, or build metadata. Artifact availability and compatibility require separate verification.
